text:
Lina H: Quick thread about the first-run checklist UI — users reported the onboarding banner + checklist feels long on small screens. Screenshot: https://figma.com/file/abc-small-screen

Aria (PM): Noted. Two asks: can we compress the checklist into collapsible steps, and can the quickstart banner include a dismissible 'Try sample' chip instead of a full button?

Ravi: Collapsible steps OK but need to keep progress visible. If collapsed, show step count and a subtle progress bar. Don't hide primary next action.

Sam C: Accessibility flag: collapsible panels must expose aria-expanded and aria-controls. Keyboard users need a visible focus ring on the panel headers.

Elaine: Copy suggestion for the chip: "Try a sample project" -> shorten to "Try a sample" to fit narrower screens. Also add microcopy under the chip: "Pre-seeded with config + prompts" so it's clearer what "sample" means.

Lina H: Mobile layout thought: switch to stacked compact cards (icon + title + 1-line blurb) — each card should be tap-to-expand rather than modal. That avoids janky navigation.

Ravi: Implementation concern: expanding multiple cards increases initial bundle size if we include templates. Solution: fetch template metadata only; fetch template payload on expand. Use /templates/manifest endpoint.

engbot: Event created: onboarding.checklist.interact with props {action, element}. Also capturing viewport.width for each event.

Sam C: Another keyboard/aria note: If we make the chip dismissible, ensure the dismiss control is reachable via tab and labeled "Dismiss quickstart" for screen readers.

Aria (PM): Let's try an A/B: Variant 1 = compact stacked cards with tap-to-expand. Variant 2 = one-line banner + "See templates" modal. Metric: percent who create a project in first session and time-to-first-project.

Elaine: Usability tweak: add a tiny animated chevron on the card to indicate expandability. But test to ensure animation doesn't distract.

Lina H: Also small copy tweak in checklist: change "Complete setup" -> "Finish setup (takes ~2 minutes)". Users asked for time estimate in tests.

Ravi: Back-end ETA: manifest endpoint + small CDN host for zipped starter artifacts = ~3 days. Frontend: accordion + analytics hook = 2 days. QA + a11y pass = 1 day. Total ~6 working days.

Sam C: For the canary, I want keyboard walkthrough recorded and a11y smoke tests (axe) run automatically. I'll add a checklist PR template for that.

Aria (PM): Great. Lina please update the Figma with stacked-card mocks and the compressed checklist. Ravi flag when manifest endpoint is ready so we can wire the variant flag. Scheduling 20m sync Friday to hand off.

Lina H: Will update Figma and add notes for a11y + copy. Will also include a tiny gif for the chevron animation idea. Thanks all!"
